input.overview: Grand Slam scores runs through singles, doubles, triples, home runs, and Grand Slam Homers. Hit the five H-O-M-E-R flyaway targets from left to right while they flash to score a Grand Slam Homer and four runs; completing them in another order still scores a Home Run. Light all three top GRAND SLAM HOMER lanes with right-flipper lane change for another four-run award. The lit SINGLE gate advances one base, the lit DOUBLE lane advances two, and T-R-I-P-L-E must be completed in order. Complete S-T-E-A-L once for 2x Bonus and again for 3x. Runs form the end-of-ball bonus.
input.simpleOverview: Hit the five H-O-M-E-R flyaway targets left to right while they flash for a Grand Slam Homer and four runs; any other completion still scores a Home Run. Use right-flipper lane change to light all three top lanes, and complete S-T-E-A-L once for 2x Bonus, then again for 3x.
input.summary: Prioritize the left-to-right H-O-M-E-R sequence because it converts the same five targets into four runs instead of one. Use lane change for missing top lanes and finish S-T-E-A-L early enough that 2x or 3x applies to the runs built afterward.

steps.text: Hit the H-O-M-E-R flyaway targets from left to right while their lights continue flashing.
Complete the sequence for a Grand Slam Homer, filling the bases and scoring four runs; an out-of-order completion scores one Home Run instead.
Use the right flipper button to rotate the top GRAND SLAM HOMER lanes toward missing letters; all three lanes award another Grand Slam Homer.
Complete S-T-E-A-L once for 2x Bonus and a second time for 3x before building more runs.

alternatives.title: Base-runner route
alternatives.when: Use this when the flyaway sequence has gone out of order or the target bank is returning dangerously.

steps.text: Shoot the lit SINGLE gate to advance runners one base or the lit DOUBLE lane to advance them two bases.
Complete T-R-I-P-L-E in order for a triple and to score runners ahead of it.
Make three consecutive spinner spins before its timer expires to advance the farthest runner one base.
Keep scoring runs through base hits, Home Runs, and Grand Slam Homers.
Reach the operator-set run threshold to collect the configured Special award.

machineSetup: Test the five flyaway H-O-M-E-R targets, three top lanes and lane change, top H-O-M-E-R saucer, SINGLE gate, DOUBLE lane, T-R-I-P-L-E targets, S-T-E-A-L targets and lanes, spinner, run display, and base lamps.
Check the installed run threshold and whether Special awards a replay, Extra Ball, or points; verify that run bonus and 2x/3x multipliers tally correctly at the outhole.

cautions.issue: Flyaway-target order changes a four-run award into a one-run award.
cautions.response: Watch for the flashing next letter and stop sweeping the bank once the sequence is broken; finish the remaining targets only when the safer Home Run is still worthwhile.
